description.value: Alpine Helicopters is one of Canada's most established rotary-wing operators, in business since 1961 and running over 20,000 flight hours per year across seven Western Canada bases. The company specializes in scenic sightseeing tours of the Canadian Rockies alongside heli-skiing, wildfire management, and back-country rescue. A touring cyclist passing through the Columbia Valley or Kootenay region might consider a scenic flight as a dramatic add-on to their mountain route.
